summary: Exclude impossible outputs from material return paths and withhold productivity recipes with no useful bonus.
details: A supported result with zero quantity, zero independent roll or an empty native shared-roll interval cannot create a material return edge, seed the candidate process cone or block a useful recipe as a carrier return.

Baseline outputs excluded from productivity, positive fractional returns, positive coproduct paths and unknown or foreign shapes retain possible return edges. Pattern-only selectors with a known empty productive-output projection withhold paid no-op research.

Controlled canonical graph and selector checks cover shared target contracts, including explicit historical field boundaries. Actual current-package catalogue changes, production, upstream finalizers and saved-world behavior remain unqualified; no biology or loop-safety exception is granted.

target_dispositions.reason: Shared material matching consumes native zero-output semantics and the canonical useful-output projection. Controlled checks do not qualify current-package production, catalogue changes or saved-world behavior.
